name: google-play-console
description: Use Google Play Console reviews, store listings, releases and Android vitals from Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Reviews, listings, releases and Android vitals
interface.longDescription: Inspect Google Play Console data from Codex or ChatGPT using a locally operated MCP server. OAuth credentials stay on the machine running the server, and the packaged tool profile is read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent reviews across my Play Store apps
Show release status and Android vitals for my app
Audit my localized Play Store listings
